theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cc_seg_segment_imrep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a τ : Euclid P) (ℓ : ℝ), ‖τ‖ = 1 → 0 < ℓ → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.carrier ⊆ segment ℝ a (a + ℓ • τ) ∧ R.measure univ < ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1, R.action ω = ∫ u in Ioo 0 ℓ, ω (a + u • τ) (fun _ => τ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
